{{Quote|It's the Jedi who keep my brothers ''enslaved''. We do your bidding. We serve at your ''whim''. I just wanted something more.|Slick berates Anakin Skywalker and Obi-Wan Kenobi|audio=Slick1-THE.flac|<ref name="The Hidden Enemy" />}}
'''Slick''' was the name of a veteran [[Clone Sergeant/Legends|clone trooper sergeant]] in the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. Named for his resourcefulness and discreetness, he began to develop a hatred for his [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Commanding officer/Legends|commanding officers]], believing that he and his fellow [[Cloning/Legends|clone]] brothers were acting as the Jedi's puppets. In [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]], Slick betrayed the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and began to pass inside information to the [[Dark Acolyte/Legends|Dark Acolyte]] [[Asajj Ventress/Legends|Asajj Ventress]] of the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]]. After the Confederacy invaded the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Christophsis/Legends|Christophsis]], Slick accompanied a faction of Republic forces under the command of [[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi Generals]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] and [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] to [[Battle of Christophsis/Legends|liberate]] the planet from the Confederate oppression.

On Christophsis, Slick led [[Slick's squad/Legends|his unit]] on a reconnaissance of a strategical location for an ambush on the Confederate [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droids]], and after returning to the [[Christophsis Republic base/Legends|Republic base]], Slick informed Ventress and the Confederate [[General/Legends|General]] [[Whorm Loathsom/Legends|Whorm Loathsom]] of the Republic's plan. The Confederacy was able to ambush the Republic forces, and Kenobi and Skywalker went to search for information in Confederacy-held territory while [[Clone Captain/Legends|Clone Captain]] [[Rex/Legends|Rex]] and [[Clone Commander/Legends|Clone Commander]] [[Cody/Legends|Cody]] stayed to find the possible Republic traitor. In the clones' following interrogation of Slick's men, Slick was revealed to be the Confederate [[Spy/Legends|spy]], and after the traitor severely damaged the Republic base's weapons depot, Rex and Cody engaged him in a brawl. Slick was apprehended, and when Skywalker and Kenobi returned, the traitorous clone was taken to lock-up.

==Biography==
===Clone traitor===
{{Quote|All of you just blindly following orders! For ''what?'' At least I got something out of all this ''suffering''.''"<br />"''Yeah, I bet you sold out your brothers for some real shiny coin, huh?''"<br />"''Yes, she offered me money, but she offered me something more important, something ''you'' wouldn't understand! ''Freedom!''<nowiki></nowiki>|Slick reveals to Rex that he sold Republic information to Asajj Ventress|audio=SlickCloneTraitor-THE.flac|<ref name="The Hidden Enemy" />}}
The [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone trooper]] nicknamed Slick for his resourcefulness and discreetness<ref name="The Hidden Enemy Decoded">{{TCW|The Hidden Enemy|d=y}}</ref> served in the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. Promoted to the rank of [[Clone Sergeant/Legends|clone sergeant]],<ref name="The Hidden Enemy" /> Slick was given his [[Slick's squad/Legends|own unit]] of [[Troop/Legends|troopers]].<ref name="Official Episode Guide: Season 1" /> However, he began to develop a hatred for his [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Commanding officer/Legends|commanding officers]]; frustrated with the [[Cloning/Legends|clones']] position in the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] [[Army/Legends|army]] as the Jedi's "puppets," Slick betrayed the Republic,<ref name="The Hidden Enemy" /> and in [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]],<ref name="The Hidden Enemy Date">{{TCWdates|116}}</ref> he began to pass secret Republic information to the [[Dark Acolyte/Legends|Dark Acolyte]] [[Asajj Ventress/Legends|Asajj Ventress]] of the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]]. In exchange, Slick received [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]], as well as what he personally believed to be freedom.<ref name="The Hidden Enemy" />

===Ambush on Christophsis===
{{Quote|This is Sergeant Slick reporting to Generals Kenobi and Skywalker. We have a candidate for an ambush site. Gus and Jester are checking it out. Double-towered business center with clear view of a major plaza.|Slick reports on a strategical ambush site on Christophsis|<ref name="Shadowed">''[[The Clone Wars: Shadowed]]''</ref>}}
[[File:BARC_speeders_Christophsis.png|thumb|left|300px|Slick leads his platoon on [[BARC speeder/Legends|BARC speeders]] to reconnoiter an ambush site on Christophsis.]]
In the seventh [[Standard week/Legends|week]] of the war,<ref name="ERC">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]''</ref><ref name="Wild Space">''[[The Clone Wars: Wild Space]]''</ref> the Confederacy invaded the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Christophsis/Legends|Christophsis]]. Slick accompanied a faction of clone troopers under the command of [[High Jedi General/Legends|High Jedi General]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] and [[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi General]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] to [[Battle of Christophsis/Legends|liberate]] the planet.<ref name="The Hidden Enemy" /> After the Republic had set up a [[Christophsis Republic base/Legends|base]], Slick led his [[Platoon/Legends|platoon]] to reconnoiter a strategic site from which to ambush the Confederate [[Droid/Legends|droid]] [[Separatist Droid Army/Legends|forces]]. In the planet's<ref name="Shadowed" /> [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[City/Legends|city]], [[Chaleydonia/Legends|Crystal City]],<ref name="Shadow Games">''[[Shadow Games]]''</ref> Slick discovered a [[Christophsis double-towered building/Legends|business complex]] with adjacent towers that faced the north and south and overlooked a major plaza. He then reported back to Skywalker and Kenobi on considering the towers as ambush sites.<ref name="Shadowed" />

As they returned to the Republic base, Slick and his men encountered a [[Squad/Legends|squad]] of [[B1-series battle droid/Legends|B1-series battle droid]]s attempting to clear a major boulevard of [[Christophsian/Legends|Christophsians]]. When the [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droids]] discovered a crippled Christophsian and discussed killing the man, the clones intervened and eliminated the droids. After returning to the base, Slick secretly transmitted the Republic's plan of attack to Ventress and the Confederate [[General/Legends|General]] [[Whorm Loathsom/Legends|Whorm Loathsom]].<ref name="Shadowed" /> The clone [[Spy/Legends|spy]] continued to send Ventress information every couple of days from a terminal in his unit's barracks.<ref name="The Hidden Enemy" />

The Republic forces stationed themselves in the two towers, preparing to ambush the [[Battalion/Legends|battalion]] of battle droids approaching in the plaza below. Kenobi, [[Clone Commander/Legends|Clone Commander]] [[Cody/Legends|Cody]], and Slick were based in the south tower, while Skywalker and [[Clone Captain/Legends|Clone Captain]] [[Rex/Legends|Rex]] were positioned in the parallel north tower. The approaching column of droids suddenly split, and acting on Slick's information, a squad of B1 battle droids ambushed Kenobi and his men in the south tower. Kenobi's forces were overwhelmed, and Skywalker arrived with his men to assist Kenobi. Fighting back the droids, the Republic forces were able to escape from the roof of the tower via [[Clone trooper pilot/Legends|clone pilot]] [[Hawk/Legends|Hawk's]] [[Low Altitude Assault Transport/infantry/Legends|LAAT/i gunship]].<ref name="The Hidden Enemy" />

Before going back to his barracks, Slick returned his [[Hush-98 comlink/Legends|Hush-98 comlink]]<ref name="The Hidden Enemy Decoded" /> to the base's command center but left the [[Comlink/Legends|device]] on so as to eavesdrop on Cody, Rex, and the Jedi as they debriefed on their failed plan. Slick learned that the Jedi believed that there was a traitor amongst their men; Skywalker and Kenobi planned to secretly investigate behind enemy lines for information, while Rex and Cody resolved to stay and search for the possible Confederate spy. After the Jedi had left, Cody noticed the activated comlink, and Rex spotted Slick in the hallway but did not recognize the traitor's identity. Slick fled, and the two clone officers gave pursuit. Slick escaped into the mess hall, blending in amongst the other clones; however, this tactic put Rex and Cody on the lead that the Confederate spy was one of the clones themselves. Returning to his barracks, Slick reported the Jedi's mission to Ventress, and the Dark Acolyte planned to confront them at the Confederacy's [[Christophsis Separatist headquarters/Legends|base]].<ref name="The Hidden Enemy" />

===Turncoat revealed===
{{Dialogue|Chopper|Everyone else turned right, toward the barracks and the mess. ''You'' turned left, toward the command center. Where were you going, sir?|Slick|Obviously, the kid feels cornered.|Cody|Sergeant! What did you mean, 'till the Jedi come back'? How did you know the Jedi were gone?|Slick|I really wish you hadn't noticed that, sir.|attr=Slick's treachery is revealed|audio=SlickCaughtfull-THE.flac|src=<ref name="The Hidden Enemy" />}}
Rex and Cody went back to the base's command center to continue their search for information. The two clones used the [[Astromech droid/Legends|astromech droid]] [[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2]] to track an irregular wavelength in external communications&mdash;that Slick had caused from contacting Ventress every few days&mdash;to the terminal in the [[Sergeant/Legends|sergeant's]] barracks. Rex and Cody decided to interrogate Slick's men, believing that one of them was the double agent. When Rex and Cody arrived at his barracks, Slick insisted on talking with his men first, stating that their morale would be damaged, but the two proceeded with the investigations anyway. When [[Chopper (clone trooper)/Legends|Chopper]] was questioned, the trooper stated he had been in the mess hall after they had returned, but fellow troopers [[Punch/Legends|Punch]] and [[Sketch/Legends|Sketch]] claimed that they had not seen him there till much later. Chopper revealed that he had been taking battle droid fingers from the battlefield&mdash;an act forbidden against war protocol&mdash;and had been stringing them together in a necklace. Slick used Chopper's discreditable situation to his own advantage, suggesting that Chopper himself was the spy.<ref name="The Hidden Enemy" />

[[File:ConfrontingSlick.png|thumb|right|250px|Slick is confronted by Cody, Rex, and his own unit.]]
However, while stating to Chopper his right to silence, Slick accidentally revealed that he was aware of the Jedi's secret mission, information he could have never otherwise known. When Cody noticed this, Slick's cover was blown, and the Republic traitor attacked Cody and Chopper before fleeing. Slick deduced that Rex and Cody would check the [[Gunship/Legends|gunship]] landing platform, believing that he was trying to escape,<ref name="The Hidden Enemy" /> and left his utility belt attached to a [[Thermal detonator/Legends|thermal detonator]] there.<ref name="The Hidden Enemy Ep Guide" /> When the two clone officers arrived at the gunship platform, Slick activated the explosives, destroying the gunships and [[All Terrain Tactical Enforcer/Legends|AT-TE walkers]] on the landing platform as well as the base's weapons depot. Slick then entered the command center and hid in the vents above; Rex and Cody followed him into the command center and engaged in a ruse to bait Slick out of the vents. Cody took the ammo out of his [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]] and left the gun on the table, while Rex seemingly left to check the south exit. Slick stole Cody's blaster and sneaked up behind the [[Commander/Legends|commander]] but discovered that the blaster was empty. Rex reentered the room, and Slick was surrounded.<ref name="The Hidden Enemy" />

Exchanging derisive words with Rex and Cody, Slick suddenly attacked Rex, stealing the captain's blaster and knocking him to the floor. Cody was able to disarm Slick but lost his own blaster in the process. As Slick headed for the door, Cody grabbed his legs and brought him down to the ground before engaging Slick in close combat. Rex ended the<ref name="The Hidden Enemy" /> evenly-matched<ref name="The Hidden Enemy Dataclip">{{CN|url=tv_shows/starwars/?episodeID=8a2505961f466bb8011f47a72a020005|text=Dataclip: The Hidden Enemy|na=video file}}</ref> pair's fight by pulling Slick off Cody, but Slick was able to knock his adversary to the floor.<ref name="The Hidden Enemy" /> Using the "[[groin popper]]" maneuver to dislocate Rex's leg,<ref name="The Hidden Enemy Decoded" /> Slick stated that while Ventress had offered him money for his information, she had also offered him freedom. However, Cody punched Slick in the head and rendered the distracted clone traitor unconscious.<ref name="The Hidden Enemy" />

As Slick reawakened, he was taken in [[Binders/Legends|handcuffs]] to the Jedi, who had returned from a duel with Ventress. Slick verbally abused the Jedi, decrying that he and his clone brothers were acting as their puppets. Slick also stated that he loved his brothers, but Cody intervened, asserting that if Slick had loved his brothers he would not have put them at risk. The traitor was taken to lock-up,<ref name="The Hidden Enemy" /> receiving a lengthy [[Prison/Legends|prison]] sentence,<ref name="What Is a Sith Warrior?">''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars: What Is a Sith Warrior?]]''</ref> while the Jedi devised a plan to continue the fight against the Confederacy with their remaining resources.<ref name="The Hidden Enemy" />

Rumors of Slick's treachery persisted many [[Standard year/Legends|years]] later, during the rule of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. In the ''[[Imperial Handbook: A Commander's Guide]]'', an [[Imperial officer/Legends|Imperial officer's]] manual published shortly before the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], the [[Kaminoan/Legends|Kaminoan]] [[Nala Se/Legends|Nala Se]] claimed that such reports were likely the result of Jedi tampering.<ref name="Handbook">''[[Star Wars: Imperial Handbook: A Commander's Guide]]''</ref>

==Personality and traits==
{{Dialogue|Slick|It's the Jedi who keep my brothers ''enslaved''. We do your bidding. We serve at your whim. I just wanted something more.|Rex|And all you had to do to get it was put the rest of us all at risk.|Slick|I&hellip;I love my brothers. You're too blind to ''see'' it, but I was striking a blow for all clones.|Cody|If you loved your brothers, you wouldn't have put them at risk.|attr=Slick defends himself against Rex and Cody|audio=SlickPandT-THE.flac|src=<ref name="The Hidden Enemy" />}}
[[File:Slick_fights_Cody.png|thumb|left|250px|Slick fights Cody.]]
Slick's [[Hair/Legends|hair]] was the generic black [[Color/Legends|color]] of the clone troopers; he shaved it off to a trim halfway up the sides of his head in a crewcut style. He also [[Hair dye|dyed]] his eyebrows a dark red.<ref name="The Hidden Enemy" /> He stood 1.83 [[Meter/Legends|meters]] tall and had brown [[Eye/Legends|eyes]] and tan skin.<ref name="TCWCE" />

As his nickname suggested, Slick was both resourceful and discreet,<ref name="The Hidden Enemy Decoded" /> taking advantage of Chopper's visibly discreditable position during interrogations. He was also able to hide his true intentions from the Jedi and his fellow clones for a time,<ref name="The Hidden Enemy" /> but although he was determined to outfox Rex and Cody, he was ultimately unable to do so when his true allegiances were revealed.<ref name="TCWCE" /> Slick knew that after he was revealed to be the traitor, Rex and Cody would deduce that he would try to escape and search the gunship landing platform. He used this to his advantage, planting explosives to delay the clones and sabotage the Republic's weapon supplies. Slick did not escape when Rex and Cody believed he would; rather, he attempted to flee after he realized that he had been outsmarted when the pair were able to bait him out of the command center's vents.<ref name="The Hidden Enemy" />

Slick professed love for his clone brothers, but possessed a hatred for the Jedi. He believed that the clone troopers were no more than cannon fodder for the Jedi, and because of this, he believed that fighting for the Republic was dishonorable. However, while Slick acted for his clone brothers, he put forth his own pursuits of greater deeds, uncaring of the danger that he imposed on his fellow clone troopers. He became a threat to his brothers in selling information to Ventress as well as sabotaging the Republic's supplies; both actions decreased the Republic's chance of defeating the Confederacy and caused greater losses when TJ-55's droids were able to outmaneuver and kill many clones based on the passed intel.<ref name="The Hidden Enemy" /> Despite this, Slick believed that he was doing the right thing for all clones and that it was worth the sacrifice.<ref name="Uncover a Hidden Enemy">{{SWArchive|url=theclonewars/news20090204.html|text=Rex and Cody must Uncover a "Hidden Enemy"}}</ref>

While Slick himself devised a plan to outmatch Rex and Cody that nearly succeeded, the two clones were able to outsmart Slick by baiting him out of the vents. Slick was capable in close combat, as evidenced by his brawl with the duo,<ref name="The Hidden Enemy" /> and as both he and Cody were veteran troopers, they were evenly matched in fighting skills,<ref name="The Hidden Enemy Dataclip" /> though eventually the loyal Clones were able to capture him. The sergeant's ruthlessness was portrayed through his violent actions, as he did not hesitate to dislocate Rex's leg.<ref name="The Hidden Enemy" />

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|It is one of the things I think is an issue in the Clone Wars, is how can the Jedi Knights use these people as a military, knowing they're basically bred for combat? And this doesn't sit well with Slick; he doesn't see it evidently as being an honorable soldier, like Rex does. I mean, Rex is the good soldier; Rex and Cody, they're very loyal, very honorable. They have all the qualities that I think a hero has, and yet Slick sees them more as, you know, cannon fodder.|Series Director [[Dave Filoni]] discusses Slick's character|<ref name="The Hidden Enemy Video Commentary">{{SW|url=video/the-hidden-enemy-episode-featurette|text="The Hidden Enemy" Episode Featurette}}</ref>}}
[[File:Traitor_revealed.png|thumb|right|250px|Sergeant Slick]]
The character of Slick was introduced in "[[The Hidden Enemy]]," an episode in the [[2008]] [[The Clone Wars: Season One|first season]] of the ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]'' television series,<ref name="The Hidden Enemy Ep Guide" /> and [[The Clone Wars: Shadowed|''Shadowed'']], an issue of the series' [[Star Wars: The Clone Wars (webcomics)|weekly webcomic]], leading into the episode.<ref name="Shadowed" /> Slick was portrayed by voice actor [[Dee Bradley Baker]], who provided the voice for all the clones throughout the series.<ref name="The Hidden Enemy Ep Guide" />

Slick was noted as being the first clone traitor introduced in the series&mdash;something considered contradictory of the clones, as they were all seemingly bred to serve the Republic and be identical in beliefs.<ref name="The Hidden Enemy Video Commentary" /> The episode's director, [[Steward Lee]], and the episode's writer, [[Drew Z. Greenberg|Drew Greenberg]], both note this detraction as "an ominous sign of [[Order 66|things to come]]," for if one clone can break from his brothers, there is no telling how many others would do the same.<ref name="Uncover a Hidden Enemy" />

Slick was originally going to have red hair, but in the final version of the episode the standard black hair of the clones was used. This helped him blend in with the other clones, rather than stand out from them.<ref name="The Hidden Enemy Ep Guide" />
